facts: About 214 million people (2026), the seventh most populous country
About 8.5 million km², the fifth-largest country by area
worth_knowing: The only Portuguese-speaking country in the Americas. It contains most of the Amazon basin, with the world's largest river system and most extensive virgin tropical forest.
